name: Zoho CRM
description: Zoho CRM is a cloud-based sales platform that uses the Zia AI assistant to manage leads, deals, and customer relationships with omnichannel engagement and no-code workflow automation.
best_for: Positioned for small businesses through enterprises across all industries, with Zoho reporting 300,000+ businesses worldwide using the platform.
features: Zia AI assistant for capturing notes, updating deals, and creating tasks by voice
Canvas Design Studio for building custom record layouts from uploaded images
No-code workflow automation, cadences, and custom functions
Predictive AI and BI-driven sales forecasting
Omnichannel engagement across email, phone, chat, and social
Business-card scanning and duplicate-contact merging in the mobile app
Integration with 1,000+ apps via Zoho Marketplace

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 3 users; leads, deals, workflows, reports, and mobile app.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Workflows, AI agents, cadences, reports, and sales forecasting ($20/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Adds CPQ, email intelligence, process automation, and inventory management ($35/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Adds an AI sales assistant, journey orchestration, territory management, and custom functions ($50/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Ultimate
tiers.notes: Adds enhanced feature limits, consulting, migration assistance, and custom AI/ML ($65/user/mo billed monthly).

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: An all-in-one CRM platform with marketing, sales, and service hubs.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses wanting an integrated marketing-to-sales CRM suite.

alternatives.name: Salesforce
alternatives.description: An enterprise-grade CRM platform with deep customization and a vast ecosystem of add-ons.
alternatives.best_for: Large enterprises needing extensive customization and scale.

alternatives.name: Pipedrive
alternatives.description: A sales-focused CRM built around a visual, pipeline-first workflow.
alternatives.best_for: Sales teams wanting a simple, activity-based pipeline tool.
